item.content:encoded:
Hugging Face Trending Models Weekly 2026-10-05

Source: Hugging Face Hub | 30 models | Generated: 2026-10-05 01:13 UTC

Today's Highlights

Qwen’s dominance continues to reshape the Hugging Face landscape, with multiple variants of Qwen3.8 and Qwen-Image-2.1 leading in both popularity and downloads. Notably, Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (16.9K likes, 6.8M downloads) stands as the most popular model, reflecting strong community trust in Qwen’s multimodal capabilities. Meanwhile, GGUF-quantized versions—especially from ISTA-DASLab and DavidAU—are surging in adoption, with over 1.6M downloads each, signaling a growing preference for lightweight, local inference. The rise of uncensored and turbo-optimized models like Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO and Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion highlights demand for high-performance, privacy-conscious alternatives.

Trending Models

🧠 Language Models (LLMs, chat models, instruction-tuned)

Model Author Likes Downloads Summary
Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B Qwen 16,940 6,821,761 A highly capable 27B-parameter vision-language model with strong conversational performance; drives massive adoption due to open weights and multimodal reasoning.
prism-ml/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-gguf prism-ml 2,416 4,045,810 A 2-bit quantized Llama-based model using ternary compression; enables near-ideal efficiency for local inference on consumer hardware.
Infatoshi/GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-EXL3-3.0bpw Infatoshi 213 946 An uncensored GLM-5.3 variant optimized for EXL3, targeting high-efficiency inference on Apple Silicon via mlx.

🎨 Multimodal & Generation (image, video, audio, text-to-X)

Model Author Likes Downloads Summary
Lightricks/LTX-2.5 Lightricks 6,312 1,626,951 A state-of-the-art image-to-video model enabling high-fidelity motion generation from stills; widely used in creative workflows.
abenzerps/Qwen-Image-2.1-Uncensored-GGUF abenzerps 3,142 1,553,744 Uncensored GGUF version of Qwen Image 2.1; extremely popular for local image generation with ComfyUI integration.
Viggle/Qwen-Image-2.1-viggle-turbo Viggle 588 272,896 Speed-optimized LoRA fine-tune of Qwen Image 2.1; praised for rapid image synthesis with minimal latency.
Alissonerdx/BFS-Best-Face-Swap Alissonerdx 1,180 203,086 High-quality face-swapping model leveraging Qwen-Image-2.1 base; notable for realism and stability in video editing pipelines.

🔧 Specialized Models (code, math, medical, embeddings)

Model Author Likes Downloads Summary
Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B Contrastive-LM 715 3,445 A contrastive learning-based verifier model for reranking and decision-making; emerging in AI safety and retrieval systems.
fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide fastino 366 53,625 A specialized NER model trained for intent classification and entity extraction; excels in structured data parsing tasks.
FermionResearch/Phonon-2 FermionResearch 202 2,635 Apple Silicon-optimized ASR model using mlx; ideal for real-time transcription on Mac hardware.

📦 Fine-tunes & Quantizations (community fine-tunes, GGUF, AWQ)

Model Author Likes Downloads Summary
ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF ISTA-DASLab 556 1,886,975 Advanced GGUF quantization using GSQ+RCO techniques; achieves 4x faster inference with minimal quality loss.
DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-...-GGUF DavidAU 1,422 2,164,143 One of the most complex GGUF builds—combining uncensored tuning, unsloth optimization, and coder-specific fine-tuning.
Venastine-Research/Xing4.0-29B-A4B-GGUF Venastine-Research 281 14,361 A highly compressed 29B model with A4B quantization; targets edge deployment with low memory footprint.
orcarouter/OrcaSAQ-2-Cyber-27B-Uncensored-GGUF orcarouter 361 14,195 A cyber-optimized, uncensored Orca variant using GGUF; favored by developers seeking aggressive behavior and local execution.

Ecosystem Signal

The Hugging Face ecosystem in October 2026 is defined by Qwen’s hegemony, with multiple variants of Qwen3.8 and Qwen-Image-2.1 dominating both metrics and use cases. Open-weight models continue to thrive, particularly those leveraging GGUF quantization—a trend driven by demand for efficient, locally deployable AI. ISTA-DASLab and DavidAU lead the charge in advanced quantization (GSQ/RCO), while communities are actively building uncensored, turbo-optimized, and fine-tuned variants that prioritize speed, customization, and bypassing content restrictions. There’s a clear shift toward modular, composable AI: LoRAs for character swapping, fine-tuned image-to-video models, and purpose-built ASR systems reflect a maturing ecosystem where users aren’t just consuming models—they’re engineering them. Notably, Apple Silicon support via mlx and ComfyUI integration are key enablers of this democratization. The rise of 2-bit models like Ternary-Bonsai signals a new frontier in efficiency, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible on consumer hardware.

Worth Exploring

  1. DavidAU/Qwen3.8-27B-TURBO-Fable-Cold-Fusion-...-GGUF – This model represents the cutting edge of community-driven optimization: a fusion of uncensored tuning, unsloth fine-tuning, and multi-purpose capabilities. Ideal for developers wanting maximum control and performance in local environments.

  2. ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-GGUF – With nearly 1.9M downloads, this is the gold standard for efficient, high-speed inference. Its GSQ+RCO quantization offers an excellent balance between size, speed, and accuracy—perfect for deploying multimodal apps on modest hardware.

  3. Lightricks/LTX-2.5 – As one of the top-performing image-to-video models, it’s a must-try for creators and animators. Its ability to generate smooth, coherent video sequences from static images makes it a cornerstone of modern generative content pipelines.
